name: kettlebell squat
description: A squat holding a kettlebell at your chest. The weight in front helps you stay upright and use your legs.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Sit your hips down and back while keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are parallel or lower.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
